data.name: Silent Paradise Anthology
data.detailed_description:
Silent Paradise Anthology tells four short stories, inspired by classics of science fiction, staged as “metroidvania-style” action-adventure games.

Features shared by all four games:

  • Experience four distinct sci-fi stories. Each standalone adventure is only a couple of hours long, but they’re all connected.

  • Explore large interconnected worlds full of secrets and shortcuts! Run and jump in 2D side-scrolling environments as dangerous as they are fascinating. Reveal each corner of your detailed map and place markers to find your way.

  • Fight a diverse ensemble of deadly enemies, including many fearsome bosses.

  • Collect new abilities. Some will improve your fighting prowess and others will let you reach new places to continue your journey. Many will do both at once!

  • Learn about the history of this world. Collect clues and piece how those incidents fit together.

It all starts with Silent Paradise…

Mainland has lost contact with the submerged city of Paradise and sent you to investigate the disappearance of its inhabitants. As mainland’s auditor, you will…

  • Explore a large interconnected submarine station, from the cozy guest apartments to the dark bowels of the life-support system.

  • Shoot the security drones standing in your way to confront the fearsome Hivemind controlling them all.

  • Collect new weapons and abilities to reach new parts of the sinking city, including a grappling hook or a diving suit, among many others.

  • Discover the fate of the station and its missing inhabitants, learn more about its inception and operation… and its secret mission.

Even when you think you’ve reached the (literal) bottom of this case… more secrets are awaiting you.

… and it all ends with Lost Paradise

You’ve slept through the end of the world. The last thing you remember is being kidnapped… Now you wake up from cryosleep inside a bunker, seemingly the last human on Earth. A note from your anonymous captor encourages you to…

  • Explore the world outside the bunker to discover a ruined city, a machine factory or a hidden village…

  • Slash your sword at the bizarre machines populating this lost world. Defeat their powerful leaders to obtain the keys to the radio tower, where you will find your answers.

  • Absorb new abilities from your environment, including a dash that goes through some walls, a violent burst of power to open new paths and many more!

  • Equip mysterious talismans to benefit from their unique powers. Build yourself up to face any situation.

  • Learn about the fall of humankind, why you were kidnapped and by whom.

  • Break away from the beaten path. Discover alternate routes and ways to bypass some abilities to forge your own destiny!

Seek salvation at the top of the tower. If there's any hope left for mankind, it's you.

Waiting long after the end is a Distant Paradise…

Millions of years in the future, the Solar System is dying. Sent from Earth to scout the outer reaches of space in a desperate quest for solutions, you crash-land on the planet Soror. Under its dead-black sky, you find a mysterious temple…

  • Explore this leftover place from an ancient civilization and learn its purpose.

  • Dance with death! You have no weapon and only your newfound movement abilities can damage the chimeras infesting the temple.

  • Overcome the challenges of the temple with platforming, fighting and puzzle-solving.

  • Evolve to gain new abilities. Access different parts of the world and expand your fighting style.

  • Learn about the fate of the ancients in your quest to save your own people.

Can you uncover the forgotten purpose of this place and save Earth?

… unlocking a Secret Paradise

Each game of this anthology can be started and enjoyed on its own, but all three games hide a mysterious “Network Terminal”. Uncover them all to…

  • Unlock a brand new fourth adventure where all three protagonists join forces!

  • Swap between multiple characters, each exploring their own corner of the Network with their own unique moveset.

  • Find new abilities and upgrades… for your unseen allies. The items required to proceed are scattered across time and space and it’s up to you to find which character can open which path.

  • Collaborate to solve puzzles across time and space and reveal deep secrets!

  • Learn all about the secret history of the Precursors and how it shaped your previous adventures.

Can you write a better conclusion to the Paradise saga?

Enjoy!

Silent Paradise Anthology is for players who love exploring fascinating worlds above all else. All four games, entirely handcrafted by a solo developer, are approachable even for beginners of the genre. Enjoy!

data.short_description: Discover 4 short metroidvania sci-fi adventures! Explore a submerged city, a lost world reclaimed by machines and a mysterious temple on an alien planet. Unlock new abilities to reach more places and battle deadly foes. Piece together the story of those places and discover how they’re all connected.
